dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Features a series of 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-lateral flank. The most prominent is a closed elliptical annulus with a high-contrast transition from the dark charcoal exterior to a light-tan linear perimeter. Secondary 'C' structures exhibit irregular, fragmented boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Solid high-intensity pixel clusters are largely absent; high-intensity values are primarily distributed in linear, reticulated paths. There is a low spatial density of localized high-intensity nodes at the junctions of the pattern network.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct mid-body annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the primary closed 'O' shape serving as the central vertex relative to adjacent open loops.
